examples.text: The hillside at this point is composed of shaly rock overlaid with a peaty loam which carries a growth of heather, and its unstable condition has resulted in two landslides in the course of the railway's history.

glosses: Having a strong tendency to change.

examples.text: The dawn of the oil age was fairly recent.
